EndText:
Gray Raven Commandant, I'm about to issue you a top priority order... well, I just felt like sounding important for a second.
But first, let me say this: thank you for your hard work. Because of you and your team, we've claimed victory after victory, and now you've helped pull off something truly extraordinary.
So after some discussion, the military has decided to hold a decoration ceremony for you and everyone else in the near future. Oh, and you're the star of this ceremony, so don't be late.
— Celica

Commandant, if you're free, want to go on a date with me?
I'm on a mission in ■■■, and whenever I get a break, I wander around a bit. Turns out I don't know this place at all. I even get lost sometimes...
It'd be great if you came with me and showed me around. And while we're at it, you could tell me about what you were like back in school. Yeah, that sounds really nice!
So, Commandant, do you have time to keep me company?
— Kamui

"You look suspicious. Where did you come from?"
"I don't owe you an explanation."
"Talk tough while you still can... Once I bring the Gray Raven Commandant over, you'll regret it!"
(In the attached image, you can vaguely make out a Kuroro arguing with a familiar white figure.)
— Unknown Signal Source

Commandant, remember what we promised before? It took a little time, but it's finally ready.
I made some special preparations for this. If you want to watch a movie together in peace, that's fine. If you'd rather do something a little more exciting, that's fine too.
I'll be resting by the theater entrance for now. By the time you get here, I promise I'll be awake.
— Wanshi

Conductor, have you had the chance to try everything in the Commercial District yet? Now that things have quieted down for a while, I'd like to invite you to the art gallery and experience the new event we've prepared together.
As I write this message, I find myself thinking of all those letters we exchanged, the ones that reached so deeply into each other's hearts... and that duet we were finally able to continue.
So, Conductor, would you grant me this little wish?
— Your Iris

Commandant, things in this region still haven't settled down, so a few of us will be staying here for a while longer to carry out our missions.
Coming back to this old place has stirred up a lot of buried memories. Come to think of it, Commandant, you must have used the training room on the second floor before.
That terminal there... no, this isn't the right place to get into all that. I'll tell you the rest slowly when we meet in ■■■.
— Chrome

...There's really not much for me to add. Just use that old passage for the introduction to F.O.S.\nThe wording may be old and dated, but every word in it is sincere. That's more than enough to inspire these clueless new recruits.\n— Vanessa
